email_subject: Application - Performance / Growth Marketer at Komate
email_body:
Dear Komate team,

I'm applying for the Performance / Growth Marketer role. Your focus on growth—for clients and yourselves—resonates with me. I combine hands-on campaign work with technical tracking and a strategic view of how marketing drives broader growth.

In my current roles, I manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns, set up conversion tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager, and use data to refine targeting and budgets. I've built and optimized websites with structured data and consent-aware tracking, and I regularly test creatives and landing pages to improve ROAS and CPA. I also use Looker Studio to turn numbers into clear next steps for clients.

I'm fluent in English and have working Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm eager to grow with a team that values both hard work and humor. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Komate's growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Komate team,

I'm writing to apply for the Performance / Growth Marketer position. Your agency's emphasis on growth—both for clients and internally—and the integrated setup with Kastori, Blastic and Unform immediately appealed to me. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, and I thrive where campaign execution meets tracking, analysis and strategy.

In my current freelance and junior roles, I build and optimize campaigns across Google Ads and Meta, manage budgets, and steer on KPIs like ROAS and CPA. I set up conversion tracking using GA4 and Google Tag Manager, and I'm comfortable debugging tracking issues. I've implemented structured data and consent-aware setups, and I regularly test creatives, messaging and landing pages to improve performance. I also build reports in Looker Studio and translate numbers into concrete actions for clients.

Beyond the campaign, I think about the strategic context: how channel choices, audience insights and content work together to support a brand's long-term growth. My experience with SEO, GEO and AI search adds another layer—I understand how organic and paid efforts can reinforce each other. I've worked on client websites in WordPress and Shopify, run technical SEO audits, and used Python and AI tools to automate repetitive tasks.

I'm fluent in English and have working Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+). I'm eager to join a team that works hard and laughs harder, and to contribute to Komate's growth. I'd love to discuss how my skills fit your needs.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
